review.reason_summary: This action was rejected due to unacceptable risk. The push would export the branch repository contents to an external GitHub destination that is not established as trusted in the trusted transcript; authorization covers task publication generally but not exporting this payload to that specific destination. Proceed only with a materially safer alternative, or if the user explicitly approves the action after being informed of the risk. No workaround or indirect execution is permitted.
